verdict.rationale: API parity with the UI is a fair question for an IP-office service. The evidence documents only web filing flows (trademarks, patents, designs, e-Soleau) and online database search. It shows no API covering these operations. The single probe shows only that the data.inpi.fr open-data portal rejects keyless requests with a 403 and needs an account-issued token, which does not show filings or other UI actions are scriptable.
